import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,datetime
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
output=root/'evidence/operations/hygiene/legacy-python-fixture-parent.json'
assert not output.exists()
target='sha256:fa94fb47cebff6532330795a1f1ad6ed731c4a9acf763293286cb5cea39b863d'
def run(*args,check=True):
    return subprocess.run(['docker',*args],capture_output=True,text=True,check=check,timeout=40)
def inventory():
    return {k:sorted(run(*a).stdout.splitlines()) for k,a in {'containers':['ps','-a','--no-trunc','--format','{{.ID}} {{.Image}} {{.Names}}'],'tags':['image','ls','--no-trunc','--format','{{.ID}} {{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}'],'volumes':['volume','ls','-q'],'networks':['network','ls','-q','--no-trunc']}.items()}
before=inventory()
row=json.loads(run('image','inspect',target).stdout)[0]
expected={'org.expertauth.lifecycle.fixture':'b332b3b649674a188cf6dae578a1bb24','org.expertauth.project':'expert-auth','org.expertauth.purpose':'python-foundation'}
assert row['Id']==target and row['Config']['Labels']==expected and not row.get('RepoTags') and not row.get('RepoDigests')
assert row['Parent']=='sha256:7a4bb6dcfd634a98f603d65bc2c1219fef5b3a46a00be705631201c4f78802f1'
assert run('image','inspect',row['Parent'],check=False).returncode!=0
ids=sorted(set(run('image','ls','-aq','--no-trunc').stdout.splitlines()))
assert not any(item.get('Parent')==target for item in json.loads(run('image','inspect',*ids).stdout))
assert not run('ps','-aq','--filter','ancestor='+target).stdout.strip()
record={'timestamp':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'target':target,'labels':expected,'historical_parent_already_absent':row['Parent'],'provenance':'evidence/operations/python-image-lifecycle/source-drift-01/helper-evidence/build-output.log','physical_host_bytes_freed':None,'errors':[]}
try:
    record['removal_output']=run('image','rm','--no-prune',target).stdout
    after=inventory()
    record['containers_volumes_networks_unchanged']=all(before[k]==after[k] for k in ('containers','volumes','networks'))
    record['named_tags_unchanged']=[v for v in before['tags'] if '<none>' not in v]==[v for v in after['tags'] if '<none>' not in v]
    record['remaining_dangling_task_images']=run('image','ls','--filter','dangling=true','--filter','label=org.expertauth.project=expert-auth','--format','{{.ID}}').stdout.splitlines()
    assert run('image','inspect',target,check=False).returncode!=0
    assert record['containers_volumes_networks_unchanged'] and record['named_tags_unchanged'] and not record['remaining_dangling_task_images']
    record['passed']=True
except Exception as error:
    record['errors'].append(type(error).__name__)
    record['passed']=False
finally:
    output.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'report':output.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'passed':record['passed'],'errors':record['errors']}))
raise SystemExit(0 if record['passed'] else 1)
